title: ComputationAddSpec
description: INPUT of `dmtool -m <model> computation add <spec.json>` and `computation modify <path> --spec <spec.json>` — A12's computation shape. Add persists it; modify is a whole re-expression, so an omitted optional property is removed. Both routes are kernel-gated before writing.

computedField.description: the calculated field's ABSOLUTE path — the field this computation WRITES. It is also where the computation is PLACED, unless `group` says otherwise. A computation that reads per-row fields must compute a field INSIDE that repeatable group; to compute a non-repeatable field from per-row data, aggregate first, starring EVERY repeatable level the path crosses (e.g. Sum(Group*/Field), Sum(Outer*/Inner*/Field)) — a level left unstarred still reads per row, so else MVK_ERROR_FIELD_NOT_IN_RULEGROUP.

group.description: OPTIONAL declaring group — an ABSOLUTE group path (a ROOT group is allowed); defaults to the computed field's parent. This is where the computation LIVES, which A12 lets differ from where it WRITES: the computed field may sit in an entirely different subtree, and the stored computedFieldRelPath then walks out of this group and back down. It is also the base the operand paths render against, so it is an iteration-scope choice, not a filing one — and that is where the one restriction comes from: whenever the computation ITERATES, the computed field must lie AT OR BELOW this group (else MVK_ERROR_FIELD_NOT_IN_RULEGROUP). It iterates for either of two reasons: an operation that reads a PER-ROW field, one whose path leaves a repeatable level unstarred, whichever group declares the computation — aggregate first, starring every repeatable level (e.g. Sum(Group*/Field)), to compute outward — or a computed field that is itself in a repeatable group, which iterates with no operand at all, so a bare constant into a repeating target is refused from an unrelated group and admitted from any ancestor of it. A group that does not exist is refused with RK_NO_SUCH_GROUP.

commonPrecondition.description: optional guard (A12 DSL) shared by all alternatives

comment.description: optional explanatory note, persisted as a leading ;; comment on the first operation

alternatives.description: ≥1 (precondition?, operation, toleranceRangeOp?) tier — either one unconditional {operation} or all preconditioned {precondition, operation} (the kernel rejects mixing). Computation takes the first holding tier, but implicit validation retains every holding tier's mismatch, so preconditions must be mutually exclusive

precondition.description: the tier's guard in A12 DSL (omit for the single unconditional alternative)

operation.description: the value-expression in A12 DSL, assigned to the computed field when the precondition holds. It may not read the computed field itself — plainly (MVK_ERROR_REFERENCE_TO_CALCULATED_FIELD) or through an enum category / semantic index (MVK_ERROR_SEMANTIC_INDEX_OR_CATEGORY_FOR_ERRORFIELD, which pre-empts the plain code); the same ban covers precondition. A derived-scale mismatch against the target is reported BEFORE either, so such an operation is a two-repair rejection

toleranceRangeOp.description: optional closed tolerance band for this alternative's implicit validation; a stored computed value fires the computation's validation only when its absolute difference from the operation exceeds the selected band

errorCodesToSuppress.description: A12 IComputation.errorCodesToSuppress, serialized unchanged as an array. The kernel currently accepts only MVK_INVALID_COMPARE_DEC_PLACES; use it when a numeric operation is intentionally valid despite the static assignment-scale gate. At most one entry: A12 renders the list into a one-code @SuppressWarning pragma, so a second entry, even the same code again, is refused with MVK_UNEXPECTED_TOKEN. Omit (or pass []) for no suppression.

roundingMode.description: A12 Computation.roundingMode, spelled exactly as A12 stores it (case matters; ROUND_UP is not a spelling). Omit for Exact, which is never stored. RoundUp/RoundDown need a toleranceRangeOp on EVERY alternative: the kernel compares an unbanded alternative exactly and refuses the pair with MVK_ERROR_WRONG_ROUNDING_MODE. The mode rounds the computed value to a WHOLE number, not to the field's digits (RoundUp toward +infinity, RoundDown toward -infinity: RoundUp writes 2 for 1.25); the computation's validation still compares the unrounded operation.

messages.description: ≥1 localized self-validation message; cover every locale the model declares

locale.description: a full locale code, e.g. en_US (bare 'en' is rejected by the kernel)

text.description: the self-validation message text; may use the same kernel interpolation tokens as rule messages. A field token is admitted when the target, the operation, the common precondition or any alternative reads that field (else INVALID_FIELD). Declared in a root group, $#RuleGroup$ is RULEGROUP_IMMEDIATELY_BELOW_ROOT and $#RootGroup$ is admitted.
